title: Browser Agent
subtitle: A Chromium to open the app, capture it, compare its screens and run the E2E tests of every stack.

recorder.title: Record a test
recorder.description: Open a page in a browser window, do what the test should do, then export the steps as a Playwright, Cypress, Selenium or WebdriverIO test. Alt+click an element to check its visible text. Hovers, scrolls, drags, editable text and lists with several choices are recorded, as are iframes and open shadow roots; a dialog the page opens is answered here. The test waits for what each action caused (a page, a request, an element) instead of pausing.
recorder.recording: Recording: act in the browser window
recorder.truncated: The recording reached its limit of 300 steps; later actions were not recorded.
recorder.noSteps: No step yet. Start a recording and act in the browser window.
